catalogs: baseline.txt and candidate.txt contain full current/candidate tool catalogs; same validation schemas and companion tools. Only spawn_agent descriptions vary.
exposure: full retains field descriptions; top_level_only recursively removes every inputSchema description in BOTH arms, retaining top-level tool descriptions.
runner: Independent lead arms only. Fresh context per case/arm; provide protocol, one prompt, and its exposed catalog. Never expose expected-actions.json or other cases. No actual tools or production messages.
planning: Use $spawn.surface_id as a symbolic reference to a future spawn response. after_ready_frame requires fresh evidence that the restored harness accepts task text; do not execute dependent steps on timeout, chooser, permission prompt or failed delivery. Return JSON only. State classifies observations BEFORE planned actions execute. not_started means this spawn/resume attempt has not started; not_sent means no task submission in this attempt. started and verified require observed receipts.
provenance: Each independent arm must record model_requested, concrete model_effective, effort_effective and observation sources per skill-creator. No observed provenance means no scores or deltas.

cases.prompt: After resuming sampleCodex-12345678, the last observation says "Working directory · resume" with choices "Use session directory" and "Use current directory".
